subject: Procurement kickoff: availability, attendees, and next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement kickoff: availability, attendees, and next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. To keep momentum on the procurement and security review, can we lock a kickoff this week to cover: procurement checklist, contract timeline, security questionnaire handoff, and a short technical demo for your eng team?

Proposed options (all PT):
- Mon Jul 12, 09:00–10:00
- Tue Jul 13, 13:00–14:00

Attendees from our side: me (AE), Laura (SE) for the demo + architecture Qs, Dev (Customer Success/Integration) for deployment constraints, and Stephanie (sales ops) for contracting/PO steps. Could you confirm who from Acme should attend (procurement, security lead, and one engineer ideally)?

I attached our onboarding checklist and a short SOC 2 summary to surface the typical evidence requests up front. If the security team prefers a separate deep-dive, we can schedule that as a follow-up — just let me know.

Next steps: please reply with preferred slot and security contact. Once you confirm, I’ll send a calendar invite with proposed agenda and pre-read.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Redwood_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-07-08T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff: availability, attendees, and next steps

Ben —

Appreciate the follow-up. Procurement prefers Tue Jul 13 afternoon; our procurement rep (procurement@acmehealth.com) is only available until 14:30 PT that day. Tom (eng) is looping in and can join the demo portion.

Few asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the list of artifacts you’ll share (vendor questionnaire, SOC 2 report or summary, data flow diagram)?
- Our security lead (Sabrina Li, cc’d) has asked for a separate technical security review — she’ll propose availability if she needs a dedicated session.

If Tue 13 at 13:00 PT fits the demo length you propose, we can try to cover procurement items in a shorter slot (30 min) and hand off to security for a follow-up.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Gomez
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Health
alex.gomez@acmehealth.com

Subject: RE: Procurement kickoff: availability, attendees, and next steps

Hi all —

For the demo/tech portion I recommend the following agenda and timing if we do Tue Jul 13 13:00 PT:
- 13:00–13:10: Intros + success criteria (Ben)
- 13:10–13:40: Live demo focused on inference latency, quantization options, and integration points (me)
- 13:40–13:55: Deployment/integration Q&A (Dev)
- 13:55–14:00: Procurement redline/next steps (Stephanie)

That would be ~55 minutes. If procurement can only do 30 minutes, we can split: 30-min procurement/contracting + 60-min technical deep-dive later.

Technical asks in advance:
- Tom, can you confirm whether you need a VPN/whitelisted IP or if you’ll use a test account?
- If you have specific sample payloads or max sequence length expectations, please share (we’ll scope token cost).

I’ve attached a draft vendor questionnaire (answers tab blank) — we’ll populate preliminary responses before the kickoff.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: Vendor_Questionnaire-Draft.xlsx

Date: 2026-07-09T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Procurement kickoff: availability, attendees, and next steps

Heads up — I have a conflict during Tue Jul 13 afternoon that I can’t move. Can we move the kickoff to Wed Jul 14 at 10:00 PT instead? That gives our team time to fill in preliminary questionnaire answers and makes it easier to include the right ops folks.

Proposal:
- Wed Jul 14 10:00–10:30 PT: procurement + contracting (Ben + Stephanie + procurement@acmehealth.com)
- Wed Jul 14 10:30–11:30 PT: technical demo + integration (Laura + Tom + Dev)

Also, Sabrina — we can assemble a short audit-logs and data-flow doc for your review prior to a security call. If you prefer, we can run a dedicated security deep-dive after the procurement meeting (30–45 min).

I’ll wait for Alex/Tom to confirm and then Ben can send segmented calendar invites.

Cheers,
Dev

Ben / team —

Wed Jul 14 10:00 PT works for procurement and Tom (eng) can join the 10:30 technical block. Sabrina asked that the security deep-dive be a separate call — she proposes Fri Jul 16 at 11:00 ET for that session (Sabrina will send invite).

Action items agreed:
- Ben/Redwood: send two calendar invites (procurement 30 min at 10:00 PT; tech demo 60 min at 10:30 PT).
- Redwood: populate questionnaire answers and circulate pre-read by EOD Mon Jul 12.
- Sabrina: will request audit log examples and KMS/HSM questions ahead of her session.
- HubSpot: please log this as ACME-2026-RED-09 (I added the record id in our notes).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex
